messages.dialogue.6bdd6210292f: The villagers’ requests will help you learn about equipment, trading and combat.
messages.dialogue.e8e18ad7da59: You have told the Blacksmith that Xiaobao is safe. You can now explore Bichon City, while continuing the Peddler’s medicine delivery and the other main quests.
messages.dialogue.0c35b08af5cb: Speak to the Lord of Bichon to set your home town. Town Teleport scrolls, returning after death and logging back in will take you there.
messages.dialogue.3b96da93a200: I buy all kinds of saleable goods. You can also bring your village hunting quests to me.
messages.dialogue.4b65118372cc: Right-click an item in your bag to sell it. I buy all kinds of saleable goods.
messages.dialogue.faa0a1069e72: These are the items you recently sold here.
messages.dialogue.8ef05470f14b: I stock basic weapons, Pickaxes and six types of starter jewellery.
messages.dialogue.963dadb76e30: These items were recently sold here.
messages.dialogue.64f39db7f455: Right-click equipment in your bag to repair it.
messages.dialogue.39173dd699ba: I stock small and medium Health and Mana Potions, Talismans, Poison, Town Teleports and Random Teleports. Town Teleports return you to your home town.
messages.dialogue.29d42de3b54d: Right-click an item in your bag to deposit it. Click an item in storage to withdraw it.
messages.dialogue.dbc41e896ee8: Bichon City offers a full range of supplies, storage, crafting and trials.
messages.dialogue.4da7219aba47: I sell Town Teleports, Random Teleports and Bag Expansion Tickets, and buy saleable goods.
messages.dialogue.706669fc8bf9: Bag Expansion Tickets cost 20,000 Gold each. Each unlocks a row of 8 slots, up to 4 times. Town Teleports return you to your home town; Random Teleports move you within the current map.
messages.dialogue.c82d79e16d46: Welcome to the event. May this blessing stay with you on your journey.
messages.dialogue.f525a5b2a718: Choose a mount. You cannot fight while mounted. Press Ctrl+R or right-click the mount to mount or dismount.
messages.dialogue.64407aa012c2: Thank you for finding me. Please tell the Blacksmith I am safe.
messages.dialogue.62b3dd6b30e6: Exchange 10 portions of Wooma Water for a Wooma weapon for your class.
messages.dialogue.f23a52442ec2: Exchange 10 Wooma Water for a class weapon
messages.dialogue.d47b38d95250: Select the item in your bag that you want to sell.
messages.dialogue.f9679f231d3f: You can buy back recently sold items.
messages.dialogue.538e39e3bbbd: The Fireworks bonus is always active: monster EXP ×4 and casual-mode item drops ×5.5. Equipment bonus-stat chances before equipment and monster modifiers are 35%, 35%, 33%, 31%, 35%, 40% and 45% for tiers 1–7; untiered equipment has a 12% chance. Exceptional equipment may also gain affixes based on its star rating. Affixes are shown immediately.
messages.dialogue.0669d489e82b: Bag Expansion Tickets cost 20,000 Gold each. Each unlocks a row of 8 slots, up to 4 times. Town Teleports return you to Sunset Village; Random Teleports move you within the current map.
messages.dialogue.c42687f9217f: Bring a Treasure Map or Demon-Slaying Token to enter its challenge. Speak to me inside to begin. Leaving ends the challenge.
messages.dialogue.f3b26277bffa: You have 30 minutes to complete this challenge.
messages.dialogue.148dad4a49e4: You have 22 minutes to complete this challenge.
messages.dialogue.570bd0b3bde3: You have 15 minutes to complete this challenge.
messages.dialogue.9ddd318299d5: You have 25 minutes to complete this challenge.
messages.dialogue.939a73a52a8b: I stock small, medium, strong and special Health and Mana Potions, Talismans, Poison, Healing Potions, Mana Elixirs and Sun Potions.
messages.dialogue.8bf5522987de: Right-click an item in your bag to sell it.
messages.dialogue.1597cd20eef1: The Tower of Trials has 99 rounds. You may enter three times per day, with a time limit of 120 minutes per run.
messages.dialogue.9219108f8599: At level 35, bring Copper Ore of quality 14 or higher to become an apprentice. Smelt a Gold Ingot of quality 25 or higher to learn equipment crafting.
messages.dialogue.f2d82802be03: Right-click equipment in your bag to repair it.
messages.dialogue.f7c4fc782d0b: Your personal storage is shared between Bichon City, the village and the Snowfield.
messages.dialogue.3090308fe372: Welcome to the Bichon City travel post.
messages.dialogue.b989fa339538: Situ Qiuyan is inside Bichon Palace at (28, 35). Bring him a Treasure Map, Demon-Slaying Token or Fire Dragon Heart.
messages.dialogue.8341988df813: The Lord of Bichon nearby can send you to the palace. You still need the required ticket and must meet the challenge’s entry conditions.
messages.dialogue.56fa7f8e5a67: Travel to the Lord of Bichon
messages.npc.noChallengeTicket: You have no Treasure Map, Demon-Slaying Token or Fire Dragon Heart in your bag.
messages.dialogue.5b4289e8651b: I stock small and medium Health and Mana Potions, Talismans, Poison and Random Teleports. Buy Town Scrolls from the village Peddler.
messages.dialogue.d9a8eaac5391: Take a Town Scroll before heading out. It returns you to your home town.
messages.dialogue.b52726a92a95: I sell only small and medium Health and Mana Potions. Buy scrolls, Talismans and Poison from the village Peddler.
messages.dialogue.cce9fe355561: I sell scrolls, Talismans, Poison and Bag Expansion Tickets, and buy any sellable items.
messages.dialogue.e35140e068c2: Talismans and Poison are also available here. Bag Expansion Tickets cost 20,000 Gold each and unlock a row of 8 slots, up to 4 times. Town Scrolls return you to your home town; Random Teleports move you within the current map.
messages.dialogue.cbcade4d830c: I sell Bag Expansion Tickets, Town Scrolls, Random Teleports, Talismans and Poison. Tickets cost 20,000 Gold each and unlock 8 slots, up to 4 times.
messages.dialogue.64097e33b3f3: I stock small, medium, strong and special Health and Mana Potions, Healing Potions, Mana Elixirs and Sun Potions. Buy Talismans and Poison from the Bichon General Merchant.
messages.dialogue.0bd195d36df6: This shop sells only small and medium HP/MP potions. Buy scrolls and backpack expansion tickets from the village peddler.
messages.dialogue.aa7e7aee1eac: Scrolls and backpack expansion tickets are sold here. We also buy items that can be sold.
messages.dialogue.27548583936a: Buy supplies and bag expansion tickets
messages.dialogue.afaff4071265: Backpack expansion tickets, town scrolls and random teleport scrolls are sold here. Each ticket costs 20,000 gold and unlocks 8 slots, up to four times.
messages.dialogue.97d7566d68cc: HP and MP potions, healing potions, magic potions and sun potions are available. Buy scrolls and backpack expansion tickets from the Bichon general trader.

Random equipment bonus chances before equipment and monster bonuses: tiers 1–7 are 35%, 35%, 33%, 31%, 35%, 40% and 45%; ungraded equipment is 12%. Exceptional equipment can gain revealed affixes according to its star rating.
messages.dialogue.9df6f9869c43: Situ Qiuyan is inside Bichon Palace at (28,35). Bring Treasure Maps, Demon Orders or a Fire Dragon Heart.
